title: [Subcontracting] Refresh the transfer order lines without saving in SetIsSubcontracting
summary: The SetIsSubcontracting method on the transfer order subform now refreshes without saving, preventing unwanted save attempts that could close the page when editing fails in certain scenarios.
key_points: CurrPage.Update() changed to CurrPage.Update(false) to refresh the subform without triggering saves
Prevents save errors from propagating inside OnAfterGetCurrRecord trigger which would close the page
Maintains visibility updates for subcontracting actions while avoiding side effects from header fetches
Aligns with SetPerTaskBillingFieldsVisible pattern used elsewhere in the app
